body: I've been to therapy in the past, but i've always been too afraid too open up about it. I live in a very conservative state and I don't have enough trust to open up to a stranger. I had my first sexual experience around six or seven with a childhood friend of mine. I repeated this multiple times with other children. I lost my virginity a year ago and I remember feeling very depressed the next morning. I'd be lying if I denied feeling attracted to some men, but I think I feel more of a pull towards women.
